title: Joe Darensbourg and the Yellow Dog Blues recording
summary: Morgan mentions Darensbourg's Yellow Dog Blues hit, on which he played. Allen saw his name on the record.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: He made the Yellow Dog Blues. Yeah, well everybody knows that all over the country.
Oh, yeah. Oh, yeah. It's a jukebox hit down in New Orleans.
Yes. Well, I made that recording with him.
I didn't even know you were out here until I saw your name on that record.
Oh, yeah. Then I knew where you were. Yeah. I thought you were still in Boston maybe. They're a very nice little group.
